data.gender_notes: Theresina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek name Theresa, derived from the Greek word theoreo meaning 'to behold, to contemplate, to worship'. The name Theresina is a feminine form of Therese and is derived from the Greek word theros meaning 'God' and eros meaning 'love'. This name symbolizes rejoicing in God and contemplating His love. The name Theresina carries the meaning “Rejoycing in God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Theresina usually hope their child will grow to embody rejoycing in god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Theresina is common in various cultures, such as Portuguese, Spanish, and Italian. In Portugal and Spain, it is pronounced as 'Teresa', while in Italy, it is pronounced as 'Teresina'. The name Theresa has been popular since the Late Middle Ages due to Saint Therese of Avila and Saint Therese of Lisieux.These saints have had a significant impact on the Catholic Church and have inspired countless individuals to deepen their spiritual lives.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Theresina carries deep spiritual significance as it is derived from the Greek words theros and eros. The name Theresina reminds us that it is through contemplating and beholding God that we can truly experience and revel in His love. The name Therese is associated with various saints who have demonstrated remarkable faith, devotion, and love. As a result, the name Theresina serves as a reminder to keep our eyes fixed on God, to contemplate His love, and to revel in the grace and blessings He bestows upon us.
